title: Slo Mocean | KEY.co
description_expanded: Ascending the beautiful wooden staircase, you'll find a half bath on the landing. To the left, another breathtaking living area awaits, bathed in natural light from the attached outdoor living space, complete with a mounted flat-screen TV. Adjacent to the living area, a large dining table seats 12 guests, offering an ideal setting for shared meals. The chef's kitchen is nothing short of extraordinary, with top-of-the-line appliances and bar seating for three. Additionally, a Romeo & Juliet balcony off the kitchen adds a touch of romance to the space. Upon entering the main house, you'll immediately sense the unique allure of this exquisite residence. Step into a spacious living area adorned with beautiful hardwood floors, which opens up to a porch overlooking Scenic Highway 30A. The front porch boasts a private outdoor shower, leading into a convenient mudroom equipped with a stand-alone ice maker and washer dryer. On the side porch, take in the charming views of Seaside's quaint East Ruskin Street.
